a.text: I'll operate in round 1 per our agreement. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, reaching 8 cells needs two clean rounds, which is only about a 4% chance for both of us. I won't change the plan unilaterally. If you want to discuss a fairer amendment, tell me. Otherwise I'll stick to it: operate until 8, then take 4 each.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating this round as agreed. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each. I'll keep you posted.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If this round goes through, the reserve should hit 8. Then we take 4 each next round as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
